yamaha-r6-2017-fim.name: Yamaha R6 2017 (FIM)
yamaha-r6-2017-fim.source: MotoSPEC v5 help-manual screenshot (screens/5-13-4-1__drex_index_custom_2.png); values transcribed by eye.
yamaha-r6-2017-fim.note: Topped-out column of the MotoSPEC file Yamaha_R6_2017_FIM.MS3 is the measurement baseline. Rf 304.46 derived from that column's ground-trail identity. Mass/CG, aero share and sprocket position are NOT in the screenshot and are deliberately absent. Rear suspension: FRAME-MOUNTED ROCKER — covered by our 'linked' mode once the 10 linkage coordinates are measured.
